# Guard cooling bandwidth is not the same resource as emission activity

31 October 2026. Separate candidate cost note, not an amendment to the frozen admission theorem or compiler. Applies to the declared loss/injection model, including the proposed operator-valued shared-spectator extension. It does not identify excitation number with thermodynamic energy.

## 1. Exact balance

Let N=sum_i n_i, and let J_loss,J_inj count the actual canonical guard loss and injection jumps during [0,T]. All actual real occupation-controlled system/bath interactions, bath-only Hamiltonians and number-conserving hopping commute with N. Intended system-only gates and instruments also preserve N. The loss and injection adjoints give

  d E[N]/dt = -sum_i lambda_i E[n_i] + sum_i a_i E[1-n_i].

Integrating their actual jump intensities proves

  E[J_loss] = E[N(0)] - E[N(T)] + E[J_inj],
  E[J_inj] <= a n T,
  E[J_loss+J_inj] <= E[N(0)] + 2 a n T.

These are expectation identities/inequalities for arbitrary finite guard/system/spectator correlations and initialized Markov fields. They do not assert a classical occupation trajectory for a coherent guard state. The actual jump-record count is well defined in the specified dilation. If a_i vary, replace a n T by integral sum_i a_i(t) dt.

## 2. A full count MGF

For u>=0 let W=exp(uN), and tilt BOTH types of jump by exp(u). The Hamiltonian contribution to the tilted adjoint on W vanishes. At a loss jump, lowering N contributes exp(-u), exactly cancelling the counting tilt; hence its entire tilted dissipator contributes zero. At an injection jump, raising N contributes exp(u), so its tilted adjoint contribution is

  a_i (exp(2u)-1)(1-n_i) W
  <= a_i (exp(2u)-1) W.

Therefore the positive non-trace-preserving tilted evolution obeys

  E exp[u(J_loss+J_inj)]
   <= Tr[exp(uN) rho_G(0)]
      exp[a n T (exp(2u)-1)].

W>=I supplies the final count inequality. System/reference/spectator registers are included by identity. Exact prescribed system-only instruments preserve W; outcome records may be retained. A guard-creating operation or modified counting convention would require a new term and is not covered.

For n finite, Tr exp(uN)rho<=exp(un), so one may derive explicit Chernoff caps. The tighter initial moment is not automatically acquired from an unknown state. In particular cold N=0 removes the initial factor, but no cold assumption

The count is exactly the sum of the specified canonical guard loss and injection jump counts. It excludes spectator/environment events, intended control operations and any other unraveling. All real allowed Hamiltonians commute with total guard occupation N: each hopping term raises one guard and lowers another even when its coefficient acts on the spectator; density-controlled terms and guard-independent terms also commute. System-only instruments preserve its expectation.

For qubit guards, the adjoint acts on N as -sum lambda_i n_i+sum a_i(1-n_i). Integrating and using the jump compensators gives the stated exact mean balance, E J_loss=E N0-E NT+E J_inj, and E(J_loss+J_inj)<=E N0+2anT. It does not posit a classical occupation path in between quantum jumps. Unequal loss rates cancel through the same integrated identity.

For u>=0 and W=exp(uN), L_loss^dagger W L_loss=lambda_i exp(-u)n_i W. Counting that jump with exp(u) exactly cancels its ordinary anticommutator term. Injection instead contributes a_i(exp(2u)-1)(1-n_i)W, bounded above by a_i(exp(2u)-1)W. Thus the positive tilted evolution and W>=I give

E exp[u(J_loss+J_inj)] <= Tr[exp(uN)rho_G(0)] exp[anT(exp(2u)-1)].

No normalization/Jensen argument for tilted states is used. The operator inequality remains valid with arbitrary finite source/system/spectator/reference correlations under the initialized Markov-field premise and the spectator domain qualifications already reviewed. The initial weighted factor is real and cannot be replaced by one without a cold-input certificate. System-only instruments leave W unchanged. If injection rates vary deterministically with time, replacing anT by their summed integral is valid.
